hero.lede: Key holders, magnets, and wall pieces. Printed, cut, and finished to the size you send.

story.title: Layers, then a finished piece.
story.lede: Scroll and the sheet comes apart: the core, the print, and the face.

layers.name: Core
layers.text: MDF for a matte cut, or acrylic when you want a glass-like body. Thickness is your choice.

layers.name: Print
layers.text: Sublimation fuses the full-colour artwork into the face. Pick a piece from the floor, or send your own art.

layers.name: Face
layers.text: A clear acrylic skin, a sealed edge, and the hooks or magnet that make it useful.

showcase.title: Artwork
showcase.text: The picture is locked first. Devotional sets, animals, characters, or a file you send.

showcase.title: Print
showcase.text: Sublimation lays the colour into a coated sheet so the art stays in the surface.

showcase.title: Cut
showcase.text: The silhouette is cut to the drawing. This owl panel was on the bench for Keoladeo National Park.

showcase.title: Hardware
showcase.text: Hooks, holes, and edges are fitted after the cut. Key rails are counted to the piece.

showcase.title: Finish check
showcase.text: Small pieces, like this Ganesha, are checked in the hand before they leave.

about.title: Made to order, piece by piece.
paragraphs: MMD Craft prints and cuts decorative panels. The floor is key holders, magnets, and wall pieces in MDF, acrylic, and sublimation.
There is no cart on this site. You choose a piece or send your own size, then the order goes out on WhatsApp with the full specification.
points: MDF for matte, paintable, sturdy cuts
Acrylic for a clear, glossy face
Hooks, holes, thickness, and quantity set by you

contact.title: Tell us what to make.
contact.lede: Call, or send a WhatsApp with the material, the size, and the quantity. Attach your artwork in the same chat.

bulk.title: Bulk enquiries.
bulk.lede: Same materials, larger counts. Tell us the piece, the quantity, and when you need them.

sale.title: Sale on.
sale.lede: These pieces are flagged for sale in the catalog. The rate is confirmed on WhatsApp.

working.title: Working on.
working.lede: Fresh cuts and pieces still on the bench. You can still ask for one.
